name: xlsx_rs
description: Reads the first visible sheet of an xlsx into its cells, in WebAssembly

scripts.build: cargo build -p xlsx_rs_js --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --remove-name-section --out-dir wasm --out-name xlsx_rs ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/xlsx_rs_js.wasm
